bugs.title: App breaks when the last task is deleted

trials.actor_reason: Deleting the last task caused a JavaScript error ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'text')') and broke the summary display.
trials.judge_reason: The bug report explicitly describes that removing the very last task kills the page and causes a console error (summary line vanishing or breaking). The execution trace and captured page error 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'text')' directly match this behavior.
judge_evidence: Action click(ref=4) successfully deleted the last task ('Buy milk').
Instrumentation recorded a hard page error: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'text')'.

DOM state delta confirms the task span and delete button were removed, but the second screenshot shows the summary text ('1 task(s). Next up: Buy milk') improperly persisted due to the unhandled exception freezing the render.
